beats.headline: Closed Off
beats.text: Rend goes into his pet carrier and Bianca is stored, because Mordecai's aura potion does not work on pets. At the door of Club Vanquisher, Carl hands Prepotente one of the yellow, bubbling potions. Mordecai made it, and it lasts an hour; the ones Prepotente had before lasted two minutes. He drinks it manually and finds it similar to a Crodino. Carl drinks his through the menu. You have been Closed Off: no longer susceptible to aura effects, Blessings or Dreads. Everyone in the area, take your aura potions, Carl orders. We're going inside.

relations.note: a shield against auras, and Li Na's are called Dreads
